items.text: Re-initialization triggered with no new context. The item still has no description, no archive materials, no tags, and no scope. All 13 plan sections remain TBD. Six prior workshop rounds produced 15+ decisions with zero user responses. No automated refinement can make progress without user input.

items.topic: What should happen with this item?
items.context: This is the same core question from round-006 d1, re-presented because initialization was re-run. The item cannot advance without one of these actions. If you want to keep this item alive, provide a description first: swarm-manager backlog update --kind idea --name effort-test --data '{"description":"YOUR DESCRIPTION HERE"}' — then re-run initialization.

options.label: Define it — add a description and re-initialize
options.rationale: Provide a description via the CLI command above, then re-run this skill. With a description, the plan scaffold and workshop decisions can be meaningfully populated.

options.label: Archive it
options.rationale: Move to archived status: swarm-manager backlog update --kind idea --name effort-test --data '{"status":"archived"}'. Keeps history, removes from active backlog.

options.label: Delete it
options.rationale: Remove entirely: swarm-manager backlog delete --kind idea --name effort-test. Appropriate if this was a workflow test.

plan_updates: No plan.md changes — all sections remain TBD. Blocked on foundational user input (item description) since round 1.
